newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Alberta Energy debt ratings.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Alberta Energy debt ratings.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Thursday it confirmed its ratings for Alberta Energy Co Ltd's long-term debt at A and its commercial paper at R-1 (low) with stable outlooks.
DBRS said AEC's acquisition early this year of Conwest Exploration resulted in a significant increase in conventional oil and gas reserves and production.
However, earnings from continuing operations experienced a sharp decline in the first half of 1996, mostly because of incremental goodwill amortization associated with the acquisition.
Earnings were also pressured by plant turnarounds and higher interest expense.
Earnings and cash flow are expected to rise over the next several years as the benefits of the merger are realized and new pipeline investments come on stream, DBRS said.
It said AEC's debt level rose by almost C$600 million from the acquisition but were reduced by a C$275-million share issue in July, which reduced net debt to under 30 percent of capitalization.
The company's annualized debt to cash flow ratio in oil and gas operations is currently under 1.5 times, "which is excellent," DBRS said.
